text:
incident-bot: Paging @Haley (on-call) — high error-rate spike detected for /v1/generate across us-west-2. Pager duty triggered (sev2). Logs: spike from 00:18:30.

Haley: seeing it. getting a terminal. looks like 502s from runtime farm, not model timeouts.

Haley: quick check — instance failure or upstream? `curl -sS http://runtime-usw2/health | jq .status` shows some nodes `unhealthy`. scaling group shows 0 pending.

Marta: I can take a look at autoscaler dashboard. might be failing health checks on kernel version.

Priya: tagging infra. @Joon FYI — can we route traffic to dedicated fallback pool while we investigate?

Joon: yes. initiating gradual reroute. running `route_tool set-policy --from=hosted --to=dedicated-fallback --pct=30 --dry-run=false` — shifting 30% now. monitor for error-rate drop.

Haley: after reroute, errors down ~40%. user impact: elevated error rate for short tail of requests (customers A, C had 5-10 minute degraded experience). sending incident banner to status page.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-178123. Severity: S2. Linked runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/runtime-502

Priya: notes for post-incident: alerts were noisy during spike — a bunch of 502 alerts triggered per-node rather than cluster-wide. we should consider deduping. also p99 latency alert fired too early.

Marta: agree. also the grafana panel we rely on for golden signals has only p50/p95. p99 is missing, so on-call couldn't see tail latency easily.

Haley: handoff — @Priya I'll go offline in 20m. can you take primary until we flip back? summarize what to watch: 1) error-rate /v1/generate (10s window) 2) p99 latency for served requests 3) runtime node health and autoscaler queue length 4) KV cache hit ratio (we saw small regressions).

Priya: taking. noted. @incident-bot mark on-call = Priya at 1781234720.

Joon: ops update — found kernel mismatch after recent image roll, causing health check fail on new nodes. rolling back image and will reimage new nodes. created ticket INFRA-3219.

Haley: thanks. while rollback in progress, we should: 1) tune alert thresholds to reduce noise (cluster-level dedupe), 2) add a dedicated dashboard for the retrospective showing golden signals + overlays of routing changes, 3) create a regression test for healthcheck after image build.

Priya: agree on dashboards. recommend panels: - cluster error-rate (5m) with annotations for routing % - p50/p95/p99 latency heatmap by model - node health (count unhealthy) + autoscaler pending jobs - KV cache hit ratio over time - request volume by model and region - streaming stalls / reconnects count

Marta: also include a drilldown: click on a spike to open logs filtered by request_id and model. Grafana can do linkVars with `${__from}` `${__to}` and `request_id`.

Joon: I can spin up a dashboard draft. sample prometheus queries:

```
# cluster error rate
sum(rate(redwood_requests_errors_total{route="/v1/generate"}[5m])) by (job)

# p99 latency (histogram)
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(redwood_request_latency_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/generate"}[5m])) by (le))

# kv cache hit ratio
sum(rate(redwood_kvcache_hits_total[5m])) / sum(rate(redwood_kvcache_requests_total[5m]))
```

Priya: nice. for alert tuning proposals:
- change node-level 502 alert to fire on `count_unhealthy_nodes > 1 for 2m` instead of single-node immediate
- add cluster-level error-rate alert: `error_rate > 5% for 3m` with dedupe across nodes
- p99 latency alert: `p99 > 3s for 5m` but only if `request_volume > 100/min` to avoid noise on low traffic models

Haley: +1. also add a suppression rule during orchestrated rollouts to avoid paging on planned deploys (we were paged on a canary failure that didn't affect traffic due to routing).

Marta: PR checklist for dashboard PR: 1) include panels with queries, 2) add template variables (region, model, route), 3) add annotations for routing% and deploy events, 4) include links to runbooks and incident ticket.

Joon: will open PR branch `engsre/dashboard/incident-178123` — target to have initial panels by EOD. assigning to @Marta for review.

Priya: post-incident action items (quick list):
- [ ] INFRA-3219: rollback and harden image build checks (Joon)
- [ ] DASH-178123: grafana dashboard + alert rule updates (Joon/Marta)
- [ ] ALERT-178123: change node dedupe and p99 threshold (Priya)
- [ ] TEST-178123: add healthcheck regression in CI (Haley)

Haley: thanks team. retrospective scheduled tomorrow 10:30am PT — add notes: customer impact timeline, routing decision timeline, alert noise sources, dashboard gaps. link: https://redwood.internal/retros/INC-2026-178123

Priya: following up — Joon opened PR https://stash.redwood/engsre/dashboards/pulls/112 with preview link. please review.

Marta: reviewed, left comments about using `dashboard links` for drilldowns and adding `p99` as a separate stat panel. look good overall. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-178123 status changed to: monitoring.

Haley: taking final note: reduce alert noise, add p99 to golden panel, add routing annotations, and ensure dedupe. marking handoff complete and back to normal ops. :white_check_mark:

Priya: closing handoff — will shepherd dashboard + alert PRs.

Joon: reimage done, cluster healthy. closing related infra ticket after verification.

Marta: adding dashboard to the SRE dashboard folder and tagging the retro doc once PR is merged.

Haley: thanks everyone. good incident response.
